name: 組み立てたサラダの材料と追加希望を確認する
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Correct ONE LH19-0011 Japanese salad review component. Image1 ORIGINAL sweetgreen source has highest authority for controls, stroke/proportion, alignment and original3 ingredient photos. Image2 is EXACT ORIGINAL hero crop (2kale,2tomatoes,avocado), image3 EXACT ORIGINAL brown dressing bowl crop; preserve actual photographs, their leaf boundaries, bowl shape, crop, shadows and colors. Image4 Japanese mock secondary content. Image5 generated v001 is correction target.
Change only artwork discrepancies: restore ORIGINAL hero and ingredient photographs rather than reconstructing different leaves or a taller dressing bowl. Keep v001 complete Japanese text, values550kcal /2ポーション /quantity1; breadON check and white right knob; disabled quantity-minus; accurate source pencil/circular±; 3 ingredient labels with preserved2line wrapping; outlined「調整する」 and forest-green-gradient「バッグに追加」. Same pure-white surface, fine neutral dividers, modest elevation. Locked Meiryo20/28Bold heading,14/24Regular body,12/16 metadata,tracking0. Source originals control disputed details; Japanese mock is secondary, not rough icon authority. No added food/control, price, calorie change, clipping or invented content.
reviewNotes: 2回目を実見。日本語・550kcal・3材料・2ポーション・パンON・数量1と無効minus・操作2点は維持。原画像の葉の輪郭・質感・器の再描画差は残り、原アートの厳密保持未達。限定2試行を保存、未受入のまま次へ。所有者承認・編集可能性・自動連動・動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
